Class Internship

java.lang.Object
Models.Entities.Internship
public class Internship extends Object
Represents an internship opportunity in the Internship Placement Management System. Manages internship details, application period, visibility, and tracks applications.

Internship lifecycle:

  • Created by Company Representative with PENDING status
  • Approved/Rejected by Career Centre Staff
  • Accepts applications during the application period
  • Marked as FILLED when all slots are confirmed

Key features:

  • Up to 10 slots per internship
  • Level-based eligibility (Basic, Intermediate, Advanced)
  • Major preference filtering
  • Visibility control by company representative
Since:
2025-11-18

  • Constructor Details

    • Internship

      public Internship()
      Default constructor for an Internship. Initializes default values: status to "Pending", visibility to true, and slots to 1.

    • Internship

      public Internship(String title, String description, String level, String preferredMajor, LocalDate openingDate, LocalDate closingDate, int slots, CompanyRepresentative representative)
      Constructs a new Internship instance with comprehensive details. Status is initialized to "Pending" and visibility to true.
      Parameters:
      title - The title of the internship.
      description - The detailed description.
      level - The required experience level.
      preferredMajor - The preferred major.
      openingDate - The application opening date.
      closingDate - The application closing date.
      slots - The total number of available positions.
      representative - The responsible CompanyRepresentative.

      public void addApplication(Application application)
      Adds a new Application to the list for this internship and updates the filled status. The application is only added if it is not null and not already present.
      Parameters:
      application - The application to add.

    • isAcceptingApplications

      public boolean isAcceptingApplications()
      Determines if the internship is currently open and accepting new applications. The conditions are:
      • The internship must be visible.
      • The status must be "Approved".
      • The current date must be between the opening and closing dates (inclusive).
      Returns:
      true if accepting applications; false otherwise.

    • toggleVisibility

      public void toggleVisibility(boolean isVisible)
      Toggles the visibility of the internship to students.
      Parameters:
      isVisible - true to make visible; false to hide.

    • checkFilledStatus

      public void checkFilledStatus()
      Recalculates the available slots and updates the internship status to "Filled" if the number of confirmed applications meets or exceeds the originalSlots. If the confirmed count drops below originalSlots, the status is reverted to "Approved".

    • displayDetails

      public void displayDetails()
      Prints all relevant details of the internship to the console in a structured format.
